caption: The drawing features a single bonnet rendered in a side view. The main part of the bonnet is a light brown or tan color with fine, parallel lines suggesting a ribbed or textured surface. A wide, pale blue ribbon, edged with darker blue and accented with small dots along its edges, is arranged in large, soft ruffles from the top left of the bonnet and hangs downward. Two green-tinted ribbon ties extend from the bottom, positioned as if to tie under the chin. Toward the lower right of the drawing, there is a smaller, simplified line sketch of the same bonnet, done without color or detailed shading. The background is plain and light beige. The name “FLORENCE EARL” appears in the lower right corner beneath the smaller sketch.
title: Bonnet
